note: Godot API names and signatures only. Each accepted gap is a shipped GodotSharp 4.5.1 member the exact game references that the headless stub deliberately does not bind; a gap not listed fails prepare. Logic-namespace entries are listed, not guessed (M2c).

category_reasons.display: Called only from presentation namespaces (Nodes, VFX, animation, audio, assets, rich-text tags); not proven per call site, so a newly reached faulting call is diagnosed as its own unknown.
category_reasons.unreferenced: No IL call site in the exact game outside generated glue.
category_reasons.tooling: Called only from debug, dev-console, AutoSlay or modding tooling.
category_reasons.display+platform: Called only from presentation namespaces (Nodes, VFX, animation, audio, assets, rich-text tags); not proven per call site, so a newly reached faulting call is diagnosed as its own unknown. Called only from multiplayer, controller or platform integration.
category_reasons.text_rendering: GlyphConverter maps font glyphs for rich-text effects; no game state.
category_reasons.platform: Called only from multiplayer, controller or platform integration.
category_reasons.save_file_io: Managed runs saves through MockGodotFileIo; GodotFileIo/FileAccessStream/BackgroundAssets directory scans are never constructed.
category_reasons.display+tooling: Called only from presentation namespaces (Nodes, VFX, animation, audio, assets, rich-text tags); not proven per call site, so a newly reached faulting call is diagnosed as its own unknown. Called only from debug, dev-console, AutoSlay or modding tooling.
category_reasons.engine_bridge: Referenced only by Godot source-generated bridge members that only the native engine invokes.
category_reasons.telemetry: Runs.Metrics upload is opted out in Managed; values are hardware telemetry with no game effect.
category_reasons.resource_loader: OneTimeInitialization registers engine resource loaders; Managed loads no Godot resources.
category_reasons.display+platform+tooling: Called only from presentation namespaces (Nodes, VFX, animation, audio, assets, rich-text tags); not proven per call site, so a newly reached faulting call is diagnosed as its own unknown. Called only from multiplayer, controller or platform integration. Called only from debug, dev-console, AutoSlay or modding tooling.
category_reasons.input_events: ScrollHelper reads touchpad/mouse events; Managed has no native input stream.
category_reasons.locale_engine: LocManager.TriggerLocaleChange forwards to the engine translation server; Managed sets locale through its own localization load.
